newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Bancaracas brokerage plans share offer.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Bancaracas brokerage plans share offer.

text.p: Venezuelan brokerage Bancaracas Mercado de Capitales has been given authorization to sound out investors with an eye to making a share offer of 58 percent of its capital, a National Securities Commission (CNV) source told Reuters Wednesday.
"The request was approved at today's meeting of directors," the CNV source said.
Bancaracas President Jose Gonzalo Muci said the issue should raise $34 million.

"This opening up is part of the company's growth process which aims to raise resources for the new businesses which it is carrying out which include derivatives, equities and fixed income," Muci said in a brief telephone interview.
Bancaracas hopes to carry out the issue towards the end of the month and plans to list the shares immediately on the Caracas Stock Exchange.
